subject: general
question: Defeat of which dynasty paved way for the establishment of Mauryan dynasty?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nanda Dynasty.**__

 
• The **Mauryan Dynasty was founded in 322 BCE by Chandragupta Maurya after overthrowing the Nanda Dynasty.**
 
• He further expanded his powers to central and western parts of India too.
 
• The Maurya Empire is considered to be one of the largest empires in Indian history.
